description: Department of Trade & Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Fish, green gram, mangoesteen etc. w.e.f. 27.10.2020
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory changes to tax rates on specific commodities, rescinds previous orders, and establishes new legal requirements for import/export duties. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
